languageModelTools.name: maintenance_route
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Scores and selects the most relevant maintenance agents for any query using keyword and capability matching. Returns combined agent context. Use this when unsure which specific agent to call, or when the query spans multiple maintenance domains.

Call this when the user's question involves Java, JDK, Maven, Gradle, Spring, Hibernate, or JEE.
